description: Angular component for a delete timeseries panel, including form handling, strategy selection, date validation, and overlay management.

classes.name: DeleteTimeseriesPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing delete timeseries panel UI, form state, and user interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form and sets up value change subscriptions.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles delete action, sets result, and disposes overlay if form is valid.

methods.name: isPeriodStrategy
methods.description: Checks if current strategy is 'delete all data for time period'.

methods.name: isDeleteLatestStrategy
methods.description: Checks if current strategy is 'delete latest value'.

methods.name: onStartDateTimeChange
methods.description: Adjusts end date if start date exceeds it.

methods.name: onEndDateTimeChange
methods.description: Adjusts start date if end date precedes it.
